title: Hearty Polish Monterey Jack Cheese Casserole
description: A nutty, flaky, and indulgent Polish dish featuring shredded Monterey Jack cheese, this casserole is perfect for a weeknight dinner and can be made dairy-free friendly, served on a beautiful Talavera plate.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Roll out the pierogi dough to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
In a large skillet, saute the onions and mushrooms in olive oil until they are softened.
In a large bowl, combine the sauteed onions and mushrooms, shredded cheese, parsley, salt, and pepper.
Place the dough in a 9x13 inch baking dish and fill with the cheese and onion mixture.
Fold the dough over the filling to form a crust and brush with a little bit of olive oil.
Bake the casserole in the preheated oven for 35 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown.
Remove the casserole from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
